Container.Name: NighttimeNinja
Container.Overview: Nighttime Ninja is a self-hosted, tablet-first kitchen manager: recipes, pantry inventory with history, shopping lists, a 7-day meal plan with a Google Calendar feed, store deals, cooking video feeds, Home Assistant support and one-click import from KitchenOwl. Sign in with Google or locally, and share a home with your family.
Container.Requires: Optional: a Google OAuth client for Google sign-in, and Kroger API keys for live prices.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, photos and the generated session secret

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people use to open the app, e.g. https://kitchen.example.com. Needed for Google sign-in and calendar links.

Config.Name: Google client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Turns on Google sign-in. Redirect URI: PUBLIC_URL/api/auth/google/callback

Config.Name: Google client secret
Config.Description: Optional. Goes with the Google client ID.

Config.Name: Sign-up mode
Config.Description: Who can make an account: invite (needs a home join code), open, or closed. The first account is always allowed and becomes the admin.

Config.Name: Quick sign-in
Config.Description: Name-only sign-in: lan (home network only), off, or anywhere. Leave empty for lan without Google, off with Google.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional. Reverse proxies allowed to set X-Forwarded headers. Defaults to loopback and private networks.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to generate one automatically in the data folder.

Config.Name: Kroger client ID
Config.Description: Optional. From developer.kroger.com, for live prices and sales.

Config.Name: Kroger client secret
Config.Description: Optional. Goes with the Kroger client ID.

Config.Name: Claude API key
Config.Description: Optional. From console.anthropic.com. Turns on the Mixologist chat and drink ideas.
